what: FungalTraits, Table S1 'Traits of genera', every sheet, row and column of the workbook's cell values, one gzip-compressed UTF-8 CSV per sheet. Line r of a CSV is the sheet's row r; field c is its column c. Unmodified: no cell is edited, added or dropped. Not carried: cell styles, column widths, row heights, rich-text formatting inside 3 strings (their text is kept), saved filter views, the thumbnail and document properties. The workbook has no formulas and no numeric cells; every non-empty cell is a shared string.
citation: Põlme, S., Abarenkov, K., Henrik Nilsson, R. et al. FungalTraits: a user-friendly traits database of fungi and fungus-like stramenopiles. Fungal Diversity 105, 1-16 (2020). https://doi.org/10.1007/s13225-020-00466-2
